name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Set the bar in the rack at mid-chest height, step under it and rest it across your upper back.
Stand up to unrack, take two short steps back and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your midsection, then sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through the whole foot to stand back up, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
cues: Big breath in and brace before every rep.
Knees travel in the same direction as your toes.
Chest stays proud as you rise.
commonMistakes: Letting the heels lift off the floor.
Knees caving inward on the way up.
Hips shooting up faster than the bar.

name: Barbell front squat
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows pushed forward and high.
Unrack, step back and set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your torso tall, squat straight down until your hips sit below knee height.
Push the floor away and lead with your elbows to stand up.
cues: Stay tall, like your back is sliding down a wall.
commonMistakes: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward.
Rounding the upper back at the bottom.

name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands under the top plate.
Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out a little.
Sit down between your legs, letting your elbows pass inside your knees.
Pause briefly, then stand up tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
cues: Keep the weight tight to your chest.
Spread the floor with your feet.
commonMistakes: Leaning forward so the weight drifts away from the body.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height, elbows pointing down.
Set your feet a little wider than hip-width.
Lower your hips straight down while keeping the bell close.
Drive up through mid-foot until your hips and knees are fully straight.
cues: Elbows brush the inside of your knees at the bottom.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Reach your arms forward as you bend your hips and knees together.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor or as deep as you can control.
Stand back up smoothly and bring your arms down.
cues: Weight spread across the whole foot.
Move at a steady, even tempo.

name: Box squat
instructions: Place a box behind you at a height that puts your thighs near parallel when seated.
Unrack the bar onto your upper back and stand in front of the box.
Push your hips back and lower under control until you lightly sit on the box.
Stay braced, then drive up off the box without rocking.
cues: Touch the box softly, never drop onto it.
Keep your shins close to vertical.

name: Leg press
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad and feet hip-width on the platform.
Release the safety handles and bend your knees to lower the platform toward you.
Stop when your knees reach roughly 90 degrees or your lower back starts to lift.
Press the platform away until your legs are straight but not locked.
cues: Lower back stays in contact with the seat.
Press through your heels and mid-foot.
commonMistakes: Locking the knees hard at the top.
Letting the hips roll off the pad at the bottom.

name: Hack squat
instructions: Step into the machine with your shoulders under the pads and back flat on the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the handles and bend your knees to lower yourself under control.
Push back up until your knees are almost straight.
cues: Control the lowering for two seconds.
commonMistakes: Shortening the range to lift heavier.

name: Smith machine squat
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and position it across your upper back.
Place your feet slightly in front of the bar, shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and lower your hips until your thighs reach parallel.
Stand back up and re-hook the bar when the set is done.
cues: Find a foot position that keeps your heels down.
commonMistakes: Placing feet too far forward so the back takes over.
Forgetting to lock the safety stops at the right height.

name: Zercher squat
instructions: Set the bar at about hip height in the rack.
Cradle the bar in the crook of your elbows with hands together.
Step back and squat down, keeping the bar close and your chest up.
Stand up by driving your hips and knees forward together.
cues: Squeeze the bar into your body.
commonMistakes: Letting the bar slide down the forearms.

name: Heels-elevated goblet squat
instructions: Rest your heels on small plates or a slant board with toes on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell at your chest with both hands.
Lower straight down, letting your knees travel well forward.
Stand back up keeping the torso upright.
commonMistakes: Lifting the heels off the plates.

name: Pause back squat
instructions: Set up exactly as for a back squat with a lighter load than usual.
Lower to the bottom position and hold still for two full seconds.
Stay braced during the pause without relaxing into the bottom.
Drive up hard to standing.
cues: Count the pause out loud in your head.
commonMistakes: Losing your brace during the hold.
Shortening the pause as you tire.

name: Landmine squat
instructions: Load one end of a barbell anchored in a landmine and hold the sleeve at your chest with both hands.
Lean slightly into the bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping the bar close to your chest.
Stand back up and squeeze your glutes at the top.
cues: Let the bar's angle guide you back.
commonMistakes: Letting the bar pull you forward.

name: Belt squat
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Hold the handles lightly for balance.
Squat down by bending hips and knees until thighs reach parallel.
Stand up tall and finish with straight hips.
cues: Use the handles for balance only.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the handles to stand up.

name: Cyclist squat
instructions: Stand with heels raised on a plate and feet close together.
Hold dumbbells at your sides or one at your chest.
Lower straight down, keeping your torso upright and knees far forward.
Rise smoothly without locking out at the top.
cues: Keep constant tension in the thighs.

name: Conventional deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Bring your shins to the bar, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar against your legs.
Lower it by pushing your hips back first, then bending the knees.
cues: Lats tight, like you are bending the bar around your legs.
Push the floor away rather than pulling with your back.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back off the floor.
Jerking the bar instead of building tension first.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height with a shoulder-width grip.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips back.
Slide the bar down your thighs until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
cues: Bar stays in contact with your legs.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees too much so it becomes a squat.
Rounding the back to reach lower.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
With a slight bend in the knees, push your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs to around mid-shin.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up tall.
cues: Long spine from head to hips.
commonMistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift away from your legs.
Looking up and straining the neck.

name: Trap bar deadlift
instructions: Step into the centre of the trap bar with feet hip-width apart.
Sit your hips down and grip the handles at their middle.
Brace, lift your chest and push through the floor to stand up.
Lower the bar under control back to the floor.
cues: Stand in the exact middle of the frame.
Shoulders over or slightly behind the handles.
commonMistakes: Dropping the bar from the top.

name: Sumo deadlift
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and toes pointing out, shins close to the bar.
Grip the bar inside your knees with arms straight down.
Push your knees out, lift your chest and pull the slack out of the bar.
Drive the floor apart with your feet to stand up, then lower under control.
cues: Spread the floor with your feet.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Stand with the kettlebell a foot in front of you and feet slightly wider than hips.
Hinge to grip the handle, then hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging, then repeat.
cues: Power comes from the hips, not the arms.
Stand tall and squeeze glutes at the top.
commonMistakes: Lifting the bell with the shoulders.

name: Barbell hip thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded bar across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip-width apart, knees bent.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause, then lower your hips toward the floor under control.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to finish the rep.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips up.
Squeeze at the top for a second, then lower slowly.
cues: Push the floor away with your heels.
commonMistakes: Feet too far from the hips.

name: Good morning
instructions: Rest a light bar across your upper back as for a squat.
Unlock your knees slightly and push your hips back.
Lean your torso forward until it is near parallel or you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to come back up.
cues: Start light and own the position.
Spine stays neutral from start to finish.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back at the bottom.

name: Cable pull-through
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope between your legs and walk forward a couple of steps.
Hinge at the hips, letting the rope travel back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
cues: Finish with a strong glute squeeze.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends straight behind you.
Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Return to standing by driving the standing hip forward.
cues: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Reach long through the back heel.

name: Back extension
instructions: Set the pad just below your hip bones and hook your ankles under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Rise until your body forms a straight line, without overarching.

name: Kettlebell deadlift
instructions: Place a kettlebell between your feet, in line with your ankles.
Hinge down and grip the handle with both hands.
Flatten your back, brace and stand up tall.
Return the bell to the floor by pushing your hips back.

name: Stiff-leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar on the floor over your mid-foot.
Keep your knees almost straight and hinge down to grip it.
Lift the bar by extending your hips, keeping legs nearly straight.
Lower it back to the floor with control on every rep.
cues: Feel the hamstrings load as you lower.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees so much it becomes a regular deadlift.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell resting across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and hold the dumbbell in place.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until level with your knees.
Pause, then lower slowly.
cues: Tuck your chin at the top.

name: Smith machine hip thrust
instructions: Place a bench perpendicular to the Smith machine and sit with your back against it.
Set the padded bar across your hips.
Unhook the bar and drive your hips up to full extension.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Forward lunge
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lower both knees to about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
commonMistakes: Stepping too short so the front knee drives far past the toes.
Letting the back knee slam the floor.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through the front heel to bring your feet back together.
Repeat on the other side.
cues: Most of the weight stays on the front leg.
Step back far enough to keep the front shin vertical.
commonMistakes: Wobbling because the feet are on a tightrope.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor.
Drive up and bring the back leg straight through into the next step.
Keep walking for the planned number of steps.
commonMistakes: Leaning the torso over the front knee.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Stand a stride in front of a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through the front foot to rise.
cues: Front foot flat the whole time.
Slight forward lean for more glutes, upright for more quads.
commonMistakes: Standing too close to the bench.

name: Split squat
instructions: Take a long stance with one foot forward and one back.
Lift the back heel and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Rise back up without moving your feet, then switch sides after the set.
commonMistakes: Feet in one line, causing wobble.

name: Barbell reverse lunge
instructions: Unrack a barbell onto your upper back.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive up through the front foot and return to standing.
Alternate sides.

name: Dumbbell step-up
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench at knee height, holding dumbbells.
Place one whole foot on the box.
Drive through that foot to stand on top, without pushing off the back leg.
Step down under control and repeat.
cues: Let the top leg do all the work.
commonMistakes: Using a box that is too tall.

name: Lateral lunge
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Take a wide step to one side and sit your hips back over that foot.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Push back to the start and repeat to the other side.
commonMistakes: Letting the bent knee cave in.
Lifting the heel of the bent leg.

name: Curtsy lunge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Return to standing and switch sides.
cues: Keep the front knee over the toes.

name: Goblet reverse lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest by the horns.
Step back with one foot and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.
cues: Keep the bell close to your chest.
commonMistakes: Losing balance from a narrow stance.

name: Smith machine split squat
instructions: Position the bar on your upper back and take a staggered stance.
Unhook the bar.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive up through the front foot and repeat, then switch legs.
cues: Front foot slightly ahead of the bar.

name: Deficit reverse lunge
instructions: Stand on a low plate or step holding dumbbells.
Step one foot back off the platform and lower deeply.
Drive through the front foot to return to the platform.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
cues: Deep stretch in the front hip.

name: Jumping lunge
instructions: Start in a lunge position with both knees bent.
Jump explosively and switch legs in the air.
Land softly back in a lunge with the other leg forward.
Keep alternating without pausing.
commonMistakes: Letting the front knee cave on landing.

name: Cossack squat
instructions: Stand with a very wide stance, toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and squat deeply on that leg.
Keep the other leg straight with toes pointing up.
Push back through the centre to the other side.
cues: Heel of the bent leg stays down.
Chest up, arms forward for balance.

name: Front-foot-elevated split squat
instructions: Place your front foot on a low plate and step the other foot back.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, getting a deep stretch.
Drive back up through the front foot.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Unrack and lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows at roughly 45 degrees.
Press the bar up and slightly back until your arms are straight.
cues: Shoulder blades pinned to the bench.
Bend the bar to keep the elbows under the wrists.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Lifting the hips off the bench.

name: Incline barbell bench press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and lie back under the bar.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and set your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar to your upper chest under control.
Press back up over your shoulders.
cues: Low incline, not a shoulder press.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Sit on the bench with dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and bring them over your chest.
Start with arms straight and palms facing your feet.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest with elbows tucked slightly.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Smooth, even pressing on both sides.
commonMistakes: Dropping the dumbbells too low and straining the shoulders.
Clanking the weights together at the top.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set the bench at 30–45 degrees and hold the dumbbells at shoulder level.
Press them up over your upper chest.
Lower slowly until your elbows are slightly below the bench line.
Press back up and repeat.
commonMistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift toward the face.

name: Push-up
instructions: Place your hands a little wider than shoulder-width and step your feet back into a plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows angled back.
Push the floor away to return to the top.
cues: Squeeze glutes and brace your middle.
commonMistakes: Only moving the head down instead of the whole body.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or sturdy box, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest to the edge of the bench.
Press back up, keeping your body in one line.
cues: The higher the surface, the easier the rep.
commonMistakes: Shrugging the shoulders to the ears.

name: Decline push-up
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
commonMistakes: Going too fast to control the bottom.

name: Machine chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.
cues: Shoulder blades stay back on the pad.
commonMistakes: Seat set too high or too low.

name: Standing cable chest press
instructions: Set both pulleys at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a staggered stance with hands beside your chest.
Press the handles forward and slightly together.
Return slowly to the start.
cues: Brace so you do not get pulled backward.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows travel behind the body.

name: Close-grip bench press
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Unrack and lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press up by straightening your arms.
Rack the bar safely after the set.
commonMistakes: Gripping so narrow the wrists bend.

name: Parallel bar dip
instructions: Support yourself on straight arms between the parallel bars.
Lean your torso slightly forward.
Bend your elbows to lower until your shoulders are just below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
cues: Shoulders down, away from the ears.
commonMistakes: Dropping too deep and stressing the shoulders.

name: Smith machine bench press
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar so it lines up with your lower chest.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and unhook the bar.
Lower the bar to your chest under control.
Press back up and re-hook at the end.
cues: Set the safety stops just above chest height.
commonMistakes: Bench in the wrong position so the bar hits the neck.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with your upper arms on the floor and dumbbells above your elbows.
Press the dumbbells straight up.
Lower until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
cues: Pause briefly with arms on the floor.
commonMistakes: Slamming the elbows into the floor.

name: Half-kneeling landmine press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the landmine bar sleeve in the hand on the same side as the down knee.
Start with the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Press it up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to the shoulder with control.
cues: Squeeze the glute of the down leg.
commonMistakes: Leaning back to finish the press.

name: Decline dumbbell press
instructions: Lock your legs into a decline bench and lie back holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up over your lower chest.
Lower them slowly toward the sides of your chest.
Press back up and repeat.
cues: Ask for a spotter when going heavy.
commonMistakes: Sitting up with the dumbbells at the end of the set.

name: Suspension trainer push-up
instructions: Hold the handles with straight arms and lean forward into a plank.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Press back up while keeping the straps from flaring.
Adjust foot position to make it easier or harder.

name: Standing barbell overhead press
instructions: Hold the bar at your collarbones with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your midsection and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly so it passes your face.
Finish with the bar over your mid-foot and head through, then lower to the collarbones.
cues: Squeeze glutes so the back does not arch.
Bar path is a straight line.
commonMistakes: Leaning back to push the weight.
Pressing the bar forward around the face.

name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Set a bench upright and sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Turn your palms forward with elbows slightly in front of your body.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.
cues: Keep your back against the pad.
commonMistakes: Arching away from the back pad.

name: Standing dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace and press both dumbbells overhead.
Finish with your arms straight beside your ears.
Lower under control.
commonMistakes: Using leg drive without meaning to.

name: Arnold press
instructions: Sit with dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with your arms straight overhead.
Reverse the rotation on the way down.
commonMistakes: Using too much weight for the range.

name: Machine shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Grip the handles and keep your back on the pad.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly to the start.
cues: Elbows slightly in front of the body.

name: Push press
instructions: Hold the bar at your collarbones as for an overhead press.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead in one motion.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders, absorbing it with your knees.
cues: Legs start it, arms finish it.
commonMistakes: Letting the chest fall forward in the dip.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips high.
Your body should form an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor in front of your hands.
Press back up to straight arms.
cues: Head travels forward of the hands.
commonMistakes: Lowering the hips into a regular push-up.

name: Standing landmine shoulder press
instructions: Stand holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Stagger your stance with the opposite foot forward.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder slowly.

name: Kettlebell overhead press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position, resting on your forearm at the shoulder.
Brace and press the bell straight up.
Finish with your bicep near your ear.
Lower it back to the rack position under control.
cues: Wrist straight, knuckles to the ceiling.

name: Smith machine shoulder press
instructions: Place an upright bench under the Smith bar.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and unhook it.
Lower it to chin level.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Keep your head out of the bar's path.
commonMistakes: Lowering too far behind the head.

name: Z press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight out in front, holding a light bar at your collarbones.
Sit tall and brace.
Press the bar overhead in a straight line.
Lower back to the collarbones.
commonMistakes: Using a load you cannot control.

name: Band overhead press
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace and press both hands overhead.
Finish with arms straight.
Lower slowly against the band's pull.

name: Wall handstand push-up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting on a wall.
Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your head toward a cushion on the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
cues: Form a triangle between hands and head.
commonMistakes: Dropping too fast onto the head.

name: Barbell bent-over row
instructions: Hold the bar with an overhand grip just wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge forward until your torso is around 45 degrees, knees soft.
Row the bar to your lower ribs by driving your elbows back.
Lower it under control to straight arms.
commonMistakes: Standing up more with every rep.
Jerking the weight with the hips.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a bench, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with arm straight.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight again.
cues: Pull toward the hip, not the chest.
commonMistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit at the row station with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle with arms straight and sit tall.
Pull the handle to your stomach while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
commonMistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth.
Rounding the back on the return.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
instructions: Set a bench at 30–45 degrees and lie face down on it.
Let a dumbbell hang in each hand.
Row both dumbbells up, driving the elbows back.
Lower slowly to full stretch.
commonMistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.

name: T-bar row
instructions: Straddle a landmine bar and attach a close-grip handle under the sleeve.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Row the handle toward your chest.
Lower under control.
commonMistakes: Standing up to move the weight.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at about waist height and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar while keeping your body straight.
Lower yourself back down slowly.
cues: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.

name: Machine row
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and the pad supports your chest.
Grip the handles with arms straight.
Pull back until your elbows pass your torso.
Return slowly to the stretched position.
cues: Move the elbows, not the hands.

name: Pendlay row
instructions: Set up with the bar on the floor and your torso nearly parallel to the ground.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Return it to the floor and reset each rep.
cues: Each rep starts from a dead stop.
commonMistakes: Raising the torso during the pull.

name: Suspension trainer row
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body rigid.
Pull your chest up to your hands.
Lower back slowly.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

name: Heavy dumbbell row (Kroc row)
instructions: Brace one hand on a bench with a staggered stance.
Hold a heavy dumbbell in the other hand.
Row it powerfully toward your hip for high reps.
Lower to a full stretch each time.
cues: Allow a little body English, but stay in control.

name: Single-arm cable row
instructions: Set a pulley at mid height and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand or kneel in a staggered stance facing the machine.
Row the handle to your side, driving the elbow back.
Reach forward slowly to the start.
cues: Let the shoulder blade move forward on the return.

name: Seal row
instructions: Lie face down on a high flat bench with a barbell below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Row the bar up until it touches the underside of the bench.
Lower under control.

name: Band row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step back until there is tension with arms straight.
Row your hands to your ribs.
Return slowly.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to start.
Pull until your chin passes the bar.
Lower to a full hang under control.
cues: Drive the elbows toward your back pockets.
commonMistakes: Half reps that skip the bottom.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Hang from the bar with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and set your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar until your chin is over it.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
commonMistakes: Craning the neck to clear the bar.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs under the pads and grip the bar just wider than shoulder-width.
Lean back slightly with your chest up.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
cues: Pull elbows down to your sides.
commonMistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Leaning far back to use body weight.

name: Close-grip lat pulldown
instructions: Attach a close-grip V handle and sit under the pulley.
Hold the handle with arms straight.
Pull it to your upper chest, elbows close to your body.
Return slowly to a full stretch.
cues: Lift your chest to meet the handle.

name: Assisted pull-up
instructions: Set the counterweight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the handles overhead.
Pull until your chin is above the handles.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
cues: Use less assistance as you get stronger.
commonMistakes: Using so much assistance the set is too easy.

name: Band-assisted pull-up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place one knee or foot in it.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull until your chin passes the bar.
Lower under control.
commonMistakes: Letting the band fling you up.

name: Negative pull-up
instructions: Stand on a box so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar and step off the box.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aiming for 3–5 seconds.
Step back up and repeat.

name: Neutral-grip pull-up
instructions: Grip parallel handles with palms facing each other.
Start from a full hang.
Pull your chest up toward the handles.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Single-arm lat pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and sit or kneel beneath it.
Reach up with one arm straight.
Pull the handle down to your side, elbow toward your hip.
Let it rise slowly to a full stretch.
cues: Lean slightly away from the working arm.
Feel the lat stretch at the top.

name: Weighted pull-up
instructions: Hold a dumbbell between your feet or wear a dip belt.
Hang with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull until your chin passes the bar.
Lower to a full hang.
cues: Only add load once you own 10 strict reps.

name: Machine pulldown (plate-loaded)
instructions: Sit with thighs secured and grip both handles overhead.
Pull the handles down toward your chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Return slowly to the top.
commonMistakes: Letting the weight yank your arms up.

name: Band lat pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high above you and kneel facing it.
Hold the ends with arms straight overhead.
Pull your elbows down to your sides.
Return slowly.
commonMistakes: Letting the band pull you up quickly.

name: Farmer's carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand from the floor with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders pulled down and back.
Walk with short, controlled steps for the target distance or time.
Set the weights down with a hinge, not by rounding.

name: Trap bar carry
instructions: Stand inside a loaded trap bar and deadlift it up.
Stand tall and brace.
Walk forward with steady, short steps.
Stop and lower the bar with a controlled hinge.

name: Suitcase carry
instructions: Hold one heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Stand tall without leaning toward the weight.
Walk for the set distance, then switch hands.
Keep your hips and shoulders level.
cues: Do not let the weight pull you sideways.
Free hand can make a fist.
commonMistakes: Leaning toward or away from the weight.

name: Kettlebell front-rack carry
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position at your shoulders.
Keep your elbows tucked and stand tall.
Walk for the set distance.
Lower the bells safely.

name: Overhead carry
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm.
Lock the arm with your bicep beside your ear.
Walk slowly for the set distance.
Switch arms and repeat.

name: Sled push
instructions: Load the sled and hold the upright poles with arms extended.
Lean forward at about 45 degrees.
Drive your legs in short powerful steps.
Push for the target distance.
cues: Push through the balls of the feet.

name: Plate pinch carry
instructions: Pinch two smooth plates together in each hand.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Walk for the target distance.
Set them down before your grip fails completely.
commonMistakes: Walking until they drop on your feet.

name: Front plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms with elbows under your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your belly button in.
Hold for the set time while breathing steadily.
cues: Push the floor away with your forearms.

name: Ab wheel rollout
instructions: Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel under your shoulders.
Brace and roll the wheel forward slowly.
Go as far as you can without your lower back arching.
Pull the wheel back to the start using your abs.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back at the far point.
Pushing the hips back first on the return.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing to the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return and repeat on the other side.
commonMistakes: Arching the back off the floor.

name: Body saw
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with feet on sliders or a towel on a smooth floor.
Push your body backward a few inches using your forearms.
Pull back to the start.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.

name: Stability ball rollout
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball with forearms resting on top.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and hips.
Go as far as you can with a flat back.
Pull back to the start.

name: Hollow body hold
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the floor.
Hold the banana shape for the set time.
cues: Bend the knees to make it easier.

name: Plank shoulder tap
instructions: Start in a high plank with feet slightly wider than hips.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back and repeat with the other hand.
Keep alternating slowly.

name: Long-lever plank
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank.
Walk your elbows forward a few inches past your shoulders.
Brace hard and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for the set time.

name: Bear plank hold
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Keep your back flat like a table.
Hold for the set time.

name: Pallof press
instructions: Set a cable handle at chest height and stand side-on to the machine.
Hold the handle at the middle of your chest with both hands.
Press it straight out and resist the pull toward the machine.
Bring it back to your chest and repeat, then switch sides.
cues: Do not let the handle drift.
commonMistakes: Standing too close for any tension.

name: Band Pallof press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the band at your chest with both hands.
Press straight out and hold for two seconds.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Side plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Hold for the set time.
Switch sides.
cues: Push the floor away with the forearm.
commonMistakes: Rolling the chest toward the floor.

name: Copenhagen plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench at the knee or ankle.
Prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body is straight, bottom leg hanging below the bench.
Hold, then switch sides.
cues: Knee on the bench is easier than ankle.

name: Bird dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are straight.
Pause, then return without letting your hips tilt.
Alternate sides.
cues: Imagine a glass of water on your lower back.
commonMistakes: Arching the back to lift the leg higher.

name: Renegade row
instructions: Get into a high plank holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Spread your feet wide for stability.
Row one dumbbell to your hip without rotating.
Lower it and repeat on the other side.
cues: Push the other dumbbell into the floor.
commonMistakes: Using weights that are too heavy.

name: Landmine rotation
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both hands at arm's length in front of your chest.
Rotate the bar down to one hip, pivoting your feet.
Bring it back through the centre and over to the other hip.
Keep your arms long throughout.
cues: Turn with the hips and feet together.
commonMistakes: Twisting through the lower back only.

name: Cable woodchop
instructions: Set a pulley high and grip the handle with both hands.
Stand side-on with feet wider than shoulders.
Pull the handle down and across your body to the opposite hip.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Side plank hip dip
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Lower your hips toward the floor a few inches.
Lift them back up past the start line.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
cues: Keep the body in one plane.
commonMistakes: Dropping all the way to the floor.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your fingertips lightly behind your ears.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Kneeling cable crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing it.
Hold the rope beside your head.
Curl your torso down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.
Return slowly to the start.
cues: Round the spine, do not hinge.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip.
Bring your knees up toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Lower your legs slowly.
Avoid swinging between reps.
cues: Tilt the pelvis up at the top.
commonMistakes: Just lifting the knees without curling.

name: Hanging leg raise
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Keep your legs straight and lift them until level with your hips or higher.
Lower them slowly.
Avoid swinging.

name: Reverse crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet lifted.
Rest your arms by your sides.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly.
cues: Lift with the abs, not momentum.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and legs raised.
Bring one knee in while turning the opposite elbow toward it.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep the pace slow and controlled.
cues: Rotate the ribcage, not just the elbows.

name: V-up
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms and legs together to meet over your hips.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat without resting on the floor.
cues: Bend the knees to scale it.

name: Decline sit-up
instructions: Hook your feet into a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Lower slowly back down.
cues: Curl up one segment at a time.

name: Stability ball crunch
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk forward until it supports your lower back.
Place hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up through your abs.
Lower back over the ball to stretch.
cues: Use the stretch at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms wide until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together in an arc.

name: Cable fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a staggered stance with arms open.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arc.
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows more to press.

name: Low-to-high cable fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest point.
Hold the handles with arms down and slightly out.
Sweep your hands up and together to chin height.
Lower slowly.

name: Pec deck
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your chest.
Hold the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of you.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.
commonMistakes: Starting too far back and straining the shoulder.

name: Incline dumbbell fly
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells above your chest.
Open your arms with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up in an arc.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows into a press.

name: Band chest fly
instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step forward with arms open wide.
Bring your hands together in front of you.
Return slowly.
commonMistakes: Letting the band pull you backward.

name: Plate squeeze press
instructions: Squeeze a light plate between your palms at chest height.
Press it straight out in front of you while squeezing hard.
Bring it back to your chest.
Keep squeezing the whole set.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly back down.

name: Cable lateral raise
instructions: Set a pulley at the lowest point and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand across your body.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
commonMistakes: Raising above shoulder height with a shrug.

name: Machine lateral raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Rest your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell front raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise them forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

name: Bent-over rear delt fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below your chest.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
cues: Think arms out wide, not back.

name: Face pull
instructions: Set a rope at upper-chest height and hold it with thumbs pointing back.
Step back with arms straight.
Pull the rope toward your face, spreading the ends apart.
Return slowly.
cues: Finish with hands beside your ears.

name: Reverse pec deck
instructions: Sit facing the pec deck pad and grip the handles with arms straight.
Sweep your arms back and out to the sides.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.
cues: Lead with the back of the hands.
commonMistakes: Squeezing shoulder blades too hard so traps take over.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Hold a light band at shoulder height with arms straight in front.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Return slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

name: Lean-away lateral raise
instructions: Hold a sturdy upright with one hand and lean away from it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand.
Raise it out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

name: Cable Y raise
instructions: Cross two low cables and hold opposite handles.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Barbell curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

name: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other.
Curl them up keeping your palms facing in.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
instructions: Lie back on a bench set to about 45 degrees with arms hanging straight.
Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower all the way down.
cues: Arms hang behind the body for a big stretch.
commonMistakes: Lifting the shoulders off the bench.

name: Preacher curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
commonMistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad.

name: Cable curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the bar with an underhand grip.
Curl it toward your chest.
Lower slowly.

name: Concentration curl
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest the back of your upper arm on your inner thigh.
Hold a dumbbell with your arm straight.
Curl it toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: EZ bar curl
instructions: Hold an EZ bar on the angled grips with palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up.
Lower slowly to full extension.
cues: Easier on the wrists than a straight bar.

name: Band curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band holding an end in each hand.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Spider curl
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
commonMistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Attach a bar to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the bar with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly back to chest level.
cues: Elbows stay glued to your ribs.

name: Rope triceps pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Hold the rope with elbows at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands under the top plate.
Lower it behind your head by bending your elbows.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the backs of your arms.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.

name: Cable overhead triceps extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley and face away from it.
Hold the rope behind your head with elbows bent.
Extend your arms forward and up until straight.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

name: Skull crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar with arms straight above your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop just before it touches.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.

name: Bench dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands beside your hips.
Slide forward so your hips are off the bench, legs extended.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
cues: Keep your back close to the bench.
commonMistakes: Dropping too low and straining the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell kickback
instructions: Support yourself on a bench with one hand and knee.
Hold a dumbbell with your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back until it is straight.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: Diamond push-up
instructions: Place your hands close together under your chest, forming a diamond with your fingers.
Step back into a plank.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Press back up.

name: Machine triceps dip
instructions: Sit in the machine and grip the handles beside you.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
Repeat.

name: Band triceps pushdown
instructions: Anchor a band above you and hold it with elbows at your sides.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

name: Straight-arm pulldown
instructions: Attach a bar or rope to a high pulley.
Stand back with arms straight and a slight hip hinge.
Sweep the bar down to your thighs, keeping arms straight.
Return slowly overhead.

name: Dumbbell pullover
instructions: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Lower it back over your head with slightly bent elbows.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Pull it back over your chest.

name: Barbell shrug
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Hold for a second.
Lower under control.

name: Prone Y raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells hanging down.
Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
commonMistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.

name: Cable shrug
instructions: Stand at a low pulley holding a straight bar.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad resting on your lower shins.
Line your knees up with the machine's pivot.
Straighten your legs fully.
Lower slowly.
cues: Hold the handles to stay seated.

name: Single-leg extension
instructions: Set up in the leg extension with one leg under the pad.
Straighten the working leg.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

name: Sissy squat
instructions: Hold a sturdy support with one hand and rise onto your toes.
Lean back as your knees travel forward and down.
Keep a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Return to standing using your thighs.

name: Spanish squat
instructions: Loop a heavy band around a fixed post and step into it so it sits behind your knees.
Walk back to create tension.
Sit back and down keeping your shins vertical.
Stand back up.
commonMistakes: Using a band that is too light.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold the position for the set time.
Stand back up slowly.

name: Reverse sled drag
instructions: Attach straps to a sled and hold them with arms straight.
Face the sled and walk backward in short steps.
Stay low with your knees bent.
Keep tension on the straps the whole time.
cues: Push through the balls of the feet.

name: Lying leg curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly to straight legs.

name: Seated leg curl
instructions: Sit with the pad behind your lower calves and the thigh pad secure.
Curl your heels down and under the seat.
Squeeze briefly.
Return slowly.
cues: Lean slightly forward for more stretch.

name: Nordic hamstring curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored.
Keep a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your body forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up.

name: Stability ball leg curl
instructions: Lie on your back with heels on a stability ball.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Curl the ball toward you by bending your knees.
Roll it back out while keeping hips up.

name: Standing cable leg curl
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the frame for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

name: Slider leg curl
instructions: Lie on your back with heels on sliders or towels.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels out until your legs are almost straight.
Pull them back in while keeping hips up.

name: Cable glute kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley.
Face the machine and hold it for support.
Kick your leg back and slightly up.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
cues: Squeeze the glute at the end.

name: Hip abduction machine
instructions: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees apart.
Pause at the widest point.
Return slowly.
cues: Lean slightly forward for more glutes.

name: Hip adduction machine
instructions: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees.
Squeeze your knees together.
Pause.
Return slowly to the stretch.

name: Banded lateral walk
instructions: Place a mini band around your thighs or ankles.
Get into a quarter squat.
Step sideways keeping tension in the band.
Take the set number of steps each way.

name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and a band around your thighs.
Keep your feet together.
Open your top knee upward.
Close it slowly, then switch sides.

name: Frog pump
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Pull your heels close to your hips.
Lift your hips by squeezing your glutes.
Lower and repeat quickly.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg extended.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Donkey kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Keep the knee bent and lift one leg until the thigh is level with your back.
Squeeze the glute.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.
cues: Sole of the foot to the ceiling.

name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Stand on the platform with the balls of your feet on the edge.
Lower your heels for a deep stretch.
Rise as high as possible onto your toes.
Pause, then lower slowly.

name: Seated calf raise
instructions: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and balls of the feet on the platform.
Lower your heels.
Push up onto your toes.
Pause at the top.

name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
instructions: Stand on a step on one foot holding a dumbbell on the same side.
Hold something for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Rise up as high as possible, then switch legs.

name: Leg press calf raise
instructions: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform.
Straighten your legs without locking them.
Push the platform away using your ankles only.
Let your heels come back for a stretch.
cues: Keep the safety handles engaged where possible.

name: Smith machine calf raise
instructions: Place a plate under the bar and stand with the balls of your feet on it.
Unhook the bar on your upper back.
Rise onto your toes.
Lower slowly.

name: Bodyweight calf raise
instructions: Stand on a step with heels hanging off the edge.
Hold a wall for balance.
Rise up onto your toes.
Lower slowly below step level.

name: Dumbbell wrist curl
instructions: Sit with forearms resting on your thighs, palms up, holding dumbbells.
Let the dumbbells roll toward your fingertips.
Curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit with forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Lift the back of your hands toward you.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse barbell curl
instructions: Hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up.
Lower slowly.

name: Dead hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet and hang with arms straight.
Hold for the set time.
Step down safely.
cues: Relaxed shoulders or active hang as programmed.

name: Towel hang
instructions: Drape two towels over a pull-up bar.
Grip one towel in each hand.
Lift your feet and hang.
Hold for the set time.

name: Wrist roller
instructions: Hold a wrist roller at shoulder height with arms straight.
Roll the weight up by twisting your wrists.
Roll it back down slowly.
Keep your arms straight.

name: Treadmill run
instructions: Start walking for a few minutes to warm up.
Increase the speed to a comfortable running pace.
Hold the pace for the planned time.
Slow to a walk to finish.

name: Incline treadmill walk
instructions: Set a moderate incline on the treadmill.
Walk at a brisk pace.
Keep your hands off the rails.
Lower the incline for the final minutes.

name: Brisk walk
instructions: Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Swing your arms naturally.
Keep going for the planned time.
Ease off for the last few minutes.

name: Stationary bike
instructions: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Pedal easily for a few minutes.
Raise the resistance to your planned effort.
Cool down with light pedalling.

name: Bike intervals
instructions: Warm up with five minutes of easy pedalling.
Pedal hard for the work interval.
Pedal easy for the rest interval.
Repeat the rounds, then cool down.
cues: Go hard on work, truly easy on rest.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Strap your feet in and grip the handle.
Push with your legs, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Return in reverse: arms, body, then legs.
Keep a steady stroke rate.
cues: Legs, body, arms; arms, body, legs.

name: Elliptical trainer
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Begin moving at an easy pace.
Increase resistance to your target effort.
Cool down at an easy pace.

name: Stair climber
instructions: Step on and start at a slow pace.
Climb with full steps.
Hold the rails lightly for balance only.
Slow down to finish.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Hold the handles with elbows close to your sides.
Turn the rope with your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back in.
Jump up and reach overhead.

name: Mountain climber
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips level.

name: Kettlebell swing intervals
instructions: Warm up with a few light swings.
Swing for the work interval.
Park the bell and rest.
Repeat for the planned rounds.

name: Sled push intervals
instructions: Load a light sled.
Push for the work distance.
Walk back and rest.
Repeat for the planned rounds.

name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Shift your hips gently forward.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: Step into a long lunge and put both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
Drop the inside elbow toward the front ankle.
Rotate that arm up to the ceiling.
Return and switch sides.
cues: Follow the hand with your eyes.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Round your back up toward the ceiling.
Then let your belly drop and lift your chest.
Move slowly between the two.

name: Open book rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms straight in front.
Open your top arm across to the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.

name: 90/90 hip switch
instructions: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one in front and one to the side.
Rotate your knees to switch sides.
Sit tall on each side.
Keep alternating slowly.
cues: Use your hands for support at first.

name: Deep squat hold
instructions: Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Press your elbows gently into your knees.
Hold the position.
Stand up slowly.

name: Standing hamstring stretch
instructions: Place one heel on a low step with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from your hips.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch.
Hold, then switch legs.

name: Pigeon stretch
instructions: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind the same wrist.
Extend the other leg straight back.
Lower your hips toward the floor.
Hold, then switch sides.
cues: Use a cushion under the hip.

name: Doorway chest stretch
instructions: Place your forearm on a door frame at shoulder height.
Step through gently.
Feel the stretch across the chest.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Foam roll upper back
instructions: Lie with a foam roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Roll slowly from mid back to shoulders.
Pause on tight spots.

name: Knee-to-wall ankle drill
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot a few inches away.
Push your knee forward to touch the wall.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Repeat, then switch sides.

name: Band shoulder pass-through
instructions: Hold a band wide in front of your thighs.
Raise it overhead and behind you with straight arms.
Bring it back to the front.
Move slowly.

name: Child's pose with side reach
instructions: Kneel and sit your hips back to your heels.
Reach your arms forward on the floor.
Walk your hands to one side for a side stretch.
Hold, then reach to the other side.

name: Pause bodyweight squat
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Sit down between your heels until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position still for two to three seconds.
Drive through the whole foot to stand up tall.
cues: Stay tall through the chest during the pause.
Keep tension in your legs; do not relax at the bottom.
commonMistakes: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of pausing.

name: Jump squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip- to shoulder-width apart.
Squat down to a comfortable depth with arms swinging back.
Jump straight up, driving the arms forward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.
cues: Reset your stance if your feet drift.
commonMistakes: Rushing reps so the squat gets shallow.

name: Assisted pistol squat
instructions: Stand on one leg next to a door frame or sturdy table and hold it lightly.
Reach the free leg forward and sit back and down on the standing leg.
Go as deep as you can control, using your hands only as much as you need.
Push through the standing foot to rise, then switch legs after the set.
cues: Use the support less as you get stronger.
commonMistakes: Pulling yourself up with the arms.
Letting the standing knee collapse inward.

name: Dumbbell front squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell on each shoulder with one end resting on it and elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your elbows high and chest up.
Drive up through the whole foot to stand.
cues: Elbows up keeps the dumbbells in place.
Brace your middle before each rep.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows drop and the chest fold forward.

name: Dumbbell sumo squat
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its end between your legs.
Push your knees out in line with your toes as you squat down.
Lower until the dumbbell nearly touches the floor or your hips reach knee height.
Squeeze your glutes and stand back up.
commonMistakes: Knees falling inward on the way up.
Stance so wide that depth becomes painful.

name: Bodyweight single-leg Romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft bend in the knee.
Push your hips back and tip your chest forward while the free leg reaches behind you.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the back of the standing thigh.
Squeeze the glute of the standing leg to return upright.
cues: Keep your hips square to the floor.
Reach both arms down for balance if it helps.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.
Opening the hips so the back leg turns out.

name: Bodyweight good morning
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your chest until you feel a firm stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
cues: Move from the hips, not the waist.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees so it turns into a squat.

name: Single-leg hip thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the edge of a bench or sturdy sofa.
Plant one foot on the floor and lift the other knee.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knee.
Lower under control and switch legs after the set.
cues: Tuck your chin and ribs as you lift.
Pause for a second at the top.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Pushing through the toes instead of the heel.

name: Kickstand dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and set one foot slightly behind you, resting on the toes.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the dumbbells down the front thigh.
Squeeze the front glute to stand back up, then switch sides after the set.
cues: The back foot is a kickstand for balance only.
Keep the dumbbells close to your leg.
commonMistakes: Sharing the weight evenly between both legs.
Rounding the back at the bottom.

name: Door frame row
instructions: Stand in a doorway and grip the frame at chest height with one hand.
Walk your feet close to the frame and lean back until your arm is straight.
Row your chest toward your hand, pulling the elbow back.
Lower slowly and switch arms after the set.
cues: Move your feet closer to the frame to make it harder.
Squeeze the shoulder blade back at the top.
commonMistakes: Twisting the body to finish the rep.
Letting the shoulder shrug up to the ear.

name: Table row
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table that will not tip and grip its edge with hands shoulder-width apart.
Straighten your body with heels on the floor, or bend your knees to make it easier.
Pull your chest up to the table edge.
Lower until your arms are straight.
cues: Check the table is solid before every set.
Keep a straight line from shoulders to heels.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips sag on the way up.
Using a light or folding table.

name: Towel door row
instructions: Loop a strong towel around the handle of a solid door that opens away from you, with the door shut.
Hold one end in each hand, walk your feet toward the door and lean back with straight arms.
Row your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
cues: Test the door and handle with a gentle lean first.
Pull the elbows back, not out.
commonMistakes: Using a door that opens toward you.
Bending at the hips instead of keeping the body straight.

name: Bent-over dumbbell row
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward until your torso is close to 45 degrees.
Let the dumbbells hang under your shoulders.
Row both dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Lower them until your arms are straight.
cues: Keep your back flat and neck long.
commonMistakes: Standing up taller on each rep.
Jerking the weights with the legs.

name: Tripod dumbbell row
instructions: Step one foot forward, hinge over and rest that hand on the front knee.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand under your shoulder.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Lower to a full stretch and switch sides after the set.
commonMistakes: Rotating the torso to swing the weight up.

name: Sliding floor pulldown
instructions: Lie face down on a smooth floor with your arms reaching overhead, hands on small towels or wearing socks on your hands.
Press your hands and forearms into the floor.
Pull your body forward toward your hands by drawing the elbows down to your sides.
Slide back to the start and repeat.
cues: Think of pulling the floor toward your hips.
Keep your legs relaxed; the back does the work.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hands off the floor.

name: Towel isometric pulldown
instructions: Hold a towel overhead with hands wider than your shoulders.
Pull the ends apart as hard as you can so the towel is tight.
Keeping it tight, draw the towel down behind or in front of your head toward your upper back.
Hold the bottom for three to five seconds, return overhead and repeat.
cues: The pull-apart creates the load; never let the towel go slack.
Drive the elbows down toward your back pockets.
commonMistakes: Letting the towel sag so there is no tension.

name: Single-arm band pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high, such as over the top of a closed door with a door anchor.
Kneel on one knee facing the anchor and hold the band in the opposite hand with your arm reaching up.
Pull your elbow down to your side until your hand is near your shoulder.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.
cues: Keep your ribs down as you pull.
Pause with the elbow at your side.
commonMistakes: Leaning far back to finish the rep.

name: Floor dumbbell pullover
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows and lower the dumbbell back behind your head toward the floor.
Stop just before it touches or when your shoulders reach their comfortable limit.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
cues: Keep your lower back on the floor.
Feel the stretch along your sides.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows so it becomes a triceps press.
Arching the back to reach further.

name: Knee push-up
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body is straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows angled back.
Push back up to straight arms.
cues: Keep the hips in line, not piked up.
Use a mat or towel under your knees.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips instead of lowering the chest.

name: Wide push-up
instructions: Set your hands about one and a half shoulder-widths apart in a high plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press the floor away to return to the top.
cues: Elbows bend out at a comfortable angle, not straight to the side.
commonMistakes: Hands so wide the shoulders hurt.

name: Archer push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands very wide and fingers turned out slightly.
Shift your weight toward one hand and bend that arm while the other stays nearly straight.
Lower until your chest is close to the working hand.
Press back up and alternate sides.
cues: The straight arm assists; the bent arm does the work.
Keep the body straight and hips level.
commonMistakes: Twisting the hips toward the floor.

name: Doorway isometric lateral raise
instructions: Stand in a narrow doorway with arms by your sides and the backs of your wrists against the frame.
Press outward into the frame as if raising your arms to the sides.
Build to a hard push and hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, rest briefly and repeat.
cues: Push from the shoulders, not by shrugging.
commonMistakes: Leaning the whole body instead of pressing with the arms.

name: Wall lean lateral raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall, about one step away, with the near elbow bent and forearm against the wall at shoulder height.
Lean your body into the wall, supported by the forearm.
Press the forearm into the wall to push your body back to upright, using the side of the shoulder.
Lean back in slowly and switch sides after the set.
cues: Stand further from the wall to make it harder.
Keep your body straight like a plank tilted sideways.
commonMistakes: Pushing with the hand like a push-up.

name: Prone T raise
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T and thumbs pointing up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your arms off the floor as high as is comfortable.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.
cues: Rest your forehead on a folded towel.
Keep the arms long and straight.
commonMistakes: Lifting the chest off the floor to cheat the height.

name: Door frame face pull
instructions: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame at face height.
Walk your feet forward and lean back until your arms are straight.
Pull your face toward the gap, bending the elbows high and out to the sides.
Lower slowly back to straight arms.
cues: Walk your feet further in to make it harder.
commonMistakes: Rowing with low elbows like a normal row.

name: Reverse snow angel
instructions: Lie face down with arms by your sides, palms down, and lift your hands just off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and up in a wide arc until they are overhead.
Reverse the arc back to your sides.
Keep the hands off the floor for the whole set.
cues: Move slowly; the hold time is what makes it hard.
commonMistakes: Letting the hands touch down to rest.

name: Seated dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
cues: Sitting removes the leg drive, so go lighter.
commonMistakes: Raising above shoulder height with a shrug.

name: Band lateral raise
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold one end in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.
cues: Use a wider stance on the band for more tension.
commonMistakes: Letting the band snap the arms down.

name: Chest-supported rear delt fly
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie face down on it holding light dumbbells.
Let the arms hang with a slight bend at the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your body.
Lower slowly.
cues: Think of moving the hands wide, not back.
Keep your chest on the pad.
commonMistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades so the back does the work.
Using weights so heavy you have to swing.

name: Band face pull
instructions: Anchor a band at face height, for example in a closed door with a door anchor.
Hold one end in each hand and step back until the band is tight.
Pull toward your face, splitting the hands apart beside your ears.
Return slowly.
cues: Finish with the hands beside the ears, not in front.
commonMistakes: Pulling to the chest like a row.
Leaning back to move the band.

name: Side-lying rear delt raise
instructions: Lie on your side on the floor or a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Let the dumbbell hang in front of your chest with a slight bend at the elbow.
Raise it up and back until the arm points to the ceiling.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.
commonMistakes: Rolling the body back to help the lift.
Bending the elbow more as you lift.

name: Towel curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a towel with one foot and hold both ends in one hand, or one end in each hand.
Curl the towel upward while pressing down with the foot to resist.
Set the resistance so each rep takes about three seconds up and three down.
Switch sides after the set if working one arm.
cues: Your foot sets the load; push hard enough to make it a real set.
Keep the elbows pinned to your sides.
commonMistakes: Easing off the foot so there is no resistance.

name: Door frame curl
instructions: Stand facing a door frame and grip it at waist height with one hand, palm up.
Walk your feet in and lean back until the arm is straight.
Curl your body toward the frame by bending only at the elbow.
Lower back slowly and switch arms after the set.
cues: Keep the elbow pointing at the frame and still.
Move the feet closer for more load.
commonMistakes: Rowing with the shoulder instead of curling.

name: Table bodyweight curl
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip its edge with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hold your body straight with heels on the floor, or knees bent to make it easier.
Curl your forehead toward your hands by bending only at the elbows.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
cues: Check the table is solid before every set.
commonMistakes: Turning it into a row by pulling the elbows down.

name: Palm press
instructions: Press your palms together in front of your chest with elbows out to the sides.
Push your hands into each other as hard as you can.
Hold for 10 to 20 seconds while breathing steadily.
Relax, then repeat at different heights.
cues: Squeeze from the chest, not the hands.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows drop to your sides.

name: Sliding floor fly
instructions: Kneel on a smooth floor with each hand on a small towel under your shoulders.
Slide your hands out to the sides as you lower your chest, with a slight bend in the elbows.
Go only as wide as you can control.
Squeeze your hands back together to return.
cues: Start from the knees; progress to a full plank.
Keep the slight elbow bend fixed.
commonMistakes: Sliding so wide you drop to the floor.

name: Floor dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing.
With a slight bend in the elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
cues: The floor sets a safe range of motion.
Hug a big tree on the way up.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows so it becomes a press.
Dropping the arms onto the floor.

name: Single-leg calf raise
